statement.note: 建表（表规范：id 物理主键 + uk service_name + gmt_*；__global__ 种子行 id=1 自举保留）

dialect.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '主键（审计行由发号器生成；__global__ 行固定为 1）', service_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '服务名（__global__=全局池计数行，其余为实例占用记录）', worker_id INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '该行机器位（全局池行=已分配到的最大值）', instance VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最近占用实例标识', gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_{table}_service_name (service_name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='雪花 worker-id 分配序列表'

statement.note: 播种全局池计数行（INSERT IGNORE：uk_service_name 冲突即忽略，幂等；id=1 自举保留值）

dialect.statement: INSERT IGNORE INTO {table} (id, service_name, worker_id, instance) VALUES (1, ?, 0, ?)

statement.note: 原子取号：LAST_INSERT_ID(expr) 把自增结果绑回会话变量（与 selectLastInsertId 须同连接/事务）

dialect.statement: UPDATE {table} SET worker_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(worker_id + 1), instance = ?, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE service_name = ?

statement.note: 会话内取回上次 LAST_INSERT_ID 值（无表访问）
记录/更新服务实例占用审计行（upsert 锚 uk_service_name——同服务重启不膨胀审计行）

dialect.statement: INSERT INTO {table} (id, service_name, worker_id, instance) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE worker_id = VALUES(worker_id), instance = VALUES(instance), gmt_modified = NOW()

statement.note: 回绕重置全局池为 0（RESET 策略用）

dialect.statement: UPDATE {table} SET worker_id = 0, instance = ?, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE service_name = ?
